About this space

Blue Mountain Beach stunner! PRIME LOCATION!

6-Seater LSV/golf cart and 4 bikes included complimentary!

Only a 5-MIN WALK to the sugar-white sands of 30A!

HUGE PRIVATE POOL (6ft+ deep!), 2 expansive porches (one screened-in), multiple living areas, multiple fireplaces, an outdoor fire pit, BBQ grill, outdoor shower, big backyard, open-concept floor plan, and walking distance to the beach, restaurants & shops!

The space

Welcome to 'Beachside Betty!'

Step into this charming two-story retreat where comfort meets coastal elegance.

As you enter the first floor, you're greeted by a spacious living area complete with a cozy fireplace, built-in wet bar, and access to the screened-in porch. Past the living area, the laundry room and the first three bedrooms are also conveniently located on this floor. The first bedroom has a Queen bed and en-suite bathroom with a glass shower. The next room also has a Queen bed, and uses a dedicated bathroom with a shower/tub combination. The third bedroom is a bunk room, with one set of Queen-over-Queen bunk beds and an en-suite bathroom with a glass shower.

Step through the living area to the screened-in porch, a peaceful spot designed for relaxation with ample cozy seating, rocking chairs, plus a daybed swing! Past the screened-in porch into the backyard, the huge 6-foot+ deep private pool invites you to unwind. Also in the backyard, enjoy sun loungers, a firepit, outdoor dining area, outdoor shower, and plenty of yard space for the kids to play!

Upstairs on the second floor, beautiful hardwood floors and exposed wood beams create the perfect coastal ambiance. The main living room features a second cozy fireplace, with ample natural light flowing in through the large doors. The open-concept floor plan flows this space seamlessly into the dining room and then the chef's kitchen, complete with high-end stainless steel appliances, granite countertops, and seating at the island for four. Stepping out through the glass doors, the expansive porch overlooks the backyard with a BBQ grill and two outdoor dining tables.

The last two bedrooms are also located on the second floor, one with a luxurious King bed and the other with a Queen bed, both sharing a bathroom with dual vanities and a glass shower.

There is parking for 3-4 cars in the driveway, along with the LSV/golf cart.

Just a 5-minute walk from the beach and other local favorites, this home is in the perfect location!

SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (Sleeps 14 Guests):

FIRST FLOOR:
- Living Area
- Bedroom 1: Queen bed, en-suite bathroom with glass shower
- Bedroom 2: Queen bed, dedicated bathroom with shower/tub combination
- Bedroom 3: Bunk room with one set of Queen-over-Queen bunks, en-suite bathroom with glass shower

SECOND FLOOR:
- Living Room
- Dining Room
- Kitchen
- Bedroom 4: King Bed, shared bathroom with dual vanities and glass shower
- Bedroom 5: Queen bed, shared bathroom with dual vanities and glass shower

There is also a pack n' play and air mattress at the home for guests' use!

Guest access

Located in such a great area of Blue Mountain Beach! It is known for its pristine white sand beach and quiet feel. Enjoy convenient access to Gulf Place Beach (and the fun shopping area there), and convenient public beach access by Goatfeathers on 30A.

WALKING distance to the beach, Local Catch, Goatfeathers Seafood & Market, and more!

Scenic Highway 30A's best restaurants nearby include Blue Mabel (walking distance), Shunk Gulley's Oyster Bar, Goatfeathers, Perfect Pig, Stinky's, Local Catch, Pizza by the Sea, The Vue 30A, Red Bar, Blue Mountain Creamery + Charlie's Donuts, Redfish Village (a great taco joint), and the new Mimmo's 30A!

Also less than a half mile to Point Washington State Forest with trails galore! Great biking all around.

Other things to note
-Pet friendly upon approval. Please inquire for non-refundable pet fee based on breed and size.
-Check in is 4:00 PM & check out is 10:00 AM. Late check out / early check in will be subject to another day's rental fees.
-Smoking is strictly prohibited.
-We provide a starter set of supplies such as toilet paper, paper towels, trash bags, dishwasher + laundry pods for your stay.
-All renters must be over 25 years of age, or if under age 25 must be accompanied by a parent/legal guardian.
-LSV/golf cart is not to be driven past the town of Seaside to the East or past Stinky's restaurant to the West. Resolving any issue from the LSV/golf cart battery dying because of the renters not charging it will be charged to the renters.
-​​Pool heating must be for the full duration of your stay and must be requested 48 hours prior to check in and paid before the heater will be turned on. Pool heating cost is $50/night of your reservation and is available October 1 - April 30.
-Damage that occurs will be collected from the renters. Guests will be held liable for any damages to the LSV.
-Southern Holiday Homes can not be held liable for any damage or injury to any persons caused by pool, fireplace, LSV/golf cart, bikes or other amenities provided to guests.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.

While the natural beauty of Santa Rosa Beach and Blue Mountain Beach can be enjoyed by anyone, those looking for an activity can check out Sandestin Golf Resort - Raven, Burnt Pine, Baytowne, The Links. 
Traveling with kids? Consider Sundog Books and Sirens at the Beach. Be sure to check out the area's animals with activities such as game walks and birdwatching.

responses.response:
Thank you for your feedback and for highlighting the features you enjoyed, including the location, amenities, and layout of the home. We’re glad to hear those aspects helped make your stay enjoyable.

We do want to clarify a few items mentioned in your review. Our team did provide the Wi-Fi information during your stay, and provided an electronic guidebook and we were happy to assist with additional trash bags when you reached out. Starter supplies are provided for guests upon arrival, and additional items can always be supplied if needed during longer stays. We’re glad we were able to assist when you contacted us.

Regarding the house manual, we apologize if there was any confusion. Our team is always available to provide information about the home, amenities, and checkout procedures, as well as sending our electronic guidebook for easy info access. However, we are reviewing this to ensure it is even clearer for future guests.

We take cleanliness and maintenance very seriously. Had we been notified during your stay about the pool, shower drain, or any pest concerns, we would have promptly sent our maintenance or pool team to address them right away. We appreciate you bringing these items to our attention so they can be inspected and resolved.

Thank you again for your feedback. We still hope to host you under better circumstances.

reviews.text: This property has a lot going for it — a great location just a 5-minute walk to the beach, a spacious and well-furnished interior, and impressive amenities including a pool, golf cart, bicycles, beach chairs, and an umbrella. For the right experience, this could easily be a 5-star stay.Unfortunately, several issues brought the overall experience down.On the positive side:• Excellent amenities (pool, golf cart, bicycles, beach chairs & umbrella)• Spacious layout with attractive furnishings• Convenient location — short walk to the beachAreas needing improvement:• No house manual was provided. Basic information — such as the Wifi password, where certain things were, and checkout instructions — required repeated outreach to the host. A house book was promised but never delivered.• Starter supplies only. For a week-long stay, we had to request essentials like trash bags. This is the first time I've encountered this in a rental.• Pool cleanliness. The pool was not clean upon arrival and required cleaning, including emptying the filters, before it could be used.• Pest concerns. A live baby cockroach was found in the bathroom, and residue beneath the sink suggested a prior infestation that had not been fully remediated or cleaned.• Clogged shower drain. The downstairs shower was clogged throughout the stay.Overall, it was an adequate stay, but the lack of proactive communication, cleanliness shortcomings, and pest evidence are concerns I'd want addressed
